ayat.text: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِیْ صَدْرِیْ ۙ وَیَسِّرْ لِیْۤ اَمْرِیْ ۙ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّنْ لِّسَانِیْ ۙ یَفْقَهُوْا قَوْلِیْ۔
رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِیْ صَدْرِیْ ۙ وَیَسِّرْ لِیْۤ اَمْرِیْ ۙ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّنْ لِّسَانِیْ ۙ یَفْقَهُوْا قَوْلِیْ۔
رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِیْ صَدْرِیْ ۙ وَیَسِّرْ لِیْۤ اَمْرِیْ ۙ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّنْ لِّسَانِیْ ۙ یَفْقَهُوْا قَوْلِیْ۔
رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِیْ صَدْرِیْ ۙ وَیَسِّرْ لِیْۤ اَمْرِیْ ۙ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّنْ لِّسَانِیْ ۙ یَفْقَهُوْا قَوْلِیْ۔
And complete the Hajj and 'Umrah for Allah.
رَبِّ اَنْزِلْنِیْ مُنْزَلًا مُّبٰرَكًا وَّاَنْتَ خَیْرُ الْمُنْزِلِیْنَ ۟
My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate us.
وَلِلّٰهِ عَلَی النَّاسِ حِجُّ الْبَیْتِ مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ اِلَیْهِ سَبِیْلًا ؕ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَنِیٌّ عَنِ الْعٰلَمِیْنَ ۟
And due to Allah from the people is a pilgrimage to the House for whoever is able to find thereto a way. But whoever disbelieves, then indeed Allah is free from need of the worlds.

hadith.expanded_reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, Book of Umrah, Chapter: The Obligation of 'Umrah and Its Virtues, Hadith 1773
hadith.text: The performance of Umrah is an expiation for the sins committed between one Umrah and the next, and the reward of Hajj Mabroor is nothing except Jannah

hadith.expanded_reference: Sunan an-Nasa'i, Book of Jihad, Chapter: The One Who Fights Seeking Reward and Fame, Hadith 3140
hadith.text: A man came to Rasulullah and said: 'What do you think of a man who fights seeking reward and fame, what will he have?' Rasulullah said: 'He will not have anything.'

hadith.expanded_reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, Book of Invocations, Chapter: The Seeking of Forgiveness by the Prophet Day and Night, Hadith 6307
hadith.text: Rasulullah, he also would ask Allah to forgive him 70 to 100 times a day

hadith.expanded_reference: Sahih Muslim, Book of Pilgrimage, Chapter: The Obligation of Hajj Once in a Lifetime, Hadith 1337
hadith.text: قَدْ فَرَضَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْكُمُ الْحَجَّ فَحُجُّوا

hadith.expanded_reference: Sahih Muslim, Book of Pilgrimage, Chapter: The Obligation of Hajj Once in a Lifetime, Hadith 1337
hadith.text: O people, Allah has made Hajj an obligation for you, so perform Hajj

hadith.expanded_reference: Sunan Abi Dawud, Book of Hajj Rites, Chapter: The Obligation of Hajj, Hadith 1721
hadith.text: Ibn Abbas said that he asked Rasulullah: 'Ya Rasulullah, Hajj is to be performed annually or only once?' Rasulullah said: 'Only once, and if anyone performs it more often, he performs a nafl'

hadith.expanded_reference: Musnad Ahmad, Musnad Bani Hashim, Hadith of Abdullah ibn Abbas, Hadith 2867
Musnad Ahmad, Musnad Bani Hashim, Hadith of Abdullah ibn Abbas, Hadith 2867
hadith.text: Hasten to do Hajj, for no one of you knows what will happen to him

hadith.expanded_reference: Sunan Abi Dawud, Book of Hajj Rites, Chapter: Hastening the Performance of Hajj, Hadith 1732
hadith.text: Whoever intends to perform Hajj, let him hasten to do so, for he may fall sick, lose his mount, or be faced with some need.

hadith.expanded_reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi, Book on Hajj, Chapter: What Has Been Related About Combining Hajj and 'Umrah, Hadith 810
hadith.text: when we perform Hajj and Umrah, then what happens? We don't become poor, that's a Hadith

hadith.expanded_reference: Sunan Abi Dawud, Book of Hajj Rites, Chapter: Combining Hajj and 'Umrah (Qiran), Hadith 1798
hadith.text: I came to Umar and said to him: I was a Christian Bedouin and I have embraced Islam. I am eager to do jihad, and I found that both Hajj and Umrah were due from me... Umar said: 'You have been guided to the practice of your Prophet.'

dua.text: لَبَّیْكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ لَبَّیْكَ، لَبَّیْكَ لَا شَرِیْكَ لَكَ لَبَّیْكَ، اِنَّ الْحَمْدَ، وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَاشَرِیْكَ لَكَ۔
اَللّٰهُمَّ ابْسُطْ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ بَرَكَاتِكَ، وَرَحْمَتِكَ، وَفَضْلِكَ، وَرِزْقِكَ.
اَللّٰهُمَّ اَسْئَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ اِلٰی وَجْهِكَ، وَالشَّوْقَ اِلٰی لِقَائِكَ فِیْ غَيْرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ وَّلَا فِتْنَةٍ مُّضِلَّةٍ۔

اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِیْ مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا اَخَّرْتُ وَمَا اَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا اَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا اَسْرَفْتُ وَمَا اَنْتَ اَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّیْ، اَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَاَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ، لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ۔
رَبِّ اَنْزِلْنِیْ مُنْزَلًا مُّبٰرَكًا وَّاَنْتَ خَیْرُ الْمُنْزِلِیْنَ ۟
سُبْحَانَكَ اللّٰهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَّاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ، اَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَاَتُوْبُ اِلَیْكَ۔

topics.description_en: Expiation of sins through consecutive Umrahs and the guaranteed reward of Paradise (Jannah) for an accepted Hajj (Hajj Mabroor).
topics.description_ur: پے در پے عمروں کے ذریعے گناہوں کا کفارہ اور حج مبرور کے بدلے جنت کی قطعی بشارت۔

topics.description_en: Fulfilling pilgrimage rites purely for the pleasure and approval of Allah, guarding against ostentation, fame, and double intentions.
topics.description_ur: ریاکاری، نام ونمود اور دوہری نیت سے بچتے ہوئے حج اور تمام عبادات کو خالصتاً رضائے الٰہی کے لیے ادا کرنا۔

topics.description_en: Distributing monetary charity and sharing food and Zamzam with pilgrims in need.

topics.description_en: Going beyond the minimum for fellow pilgrims -- caring for the elderly and gifting authentic educational literature.

topics.description_en: Maintaining constant repentance morning and evening, reflecting upon personal shortcomings, and adhering to the Prophetic tradition of istighfar.
topics.description_ur: صبح و شام کثرت سے استغفار کرنا، اپنی کوتاہیوں کا اعتراف اور روزانہ کثرت سے توبہ کی نبوی سنت پر عمل پیرا ہونا۔

topics.description_en: Enduring travel hardships with emotional resilience and remaining steadfast in obedience.

topics.description_en: Refraining from arguments and staying conscious of Allah's watchfulness at every moment.

topics.description_en: Engaging in continuous supplication, systematically compiling spiritual and life goals into a dedicated personal du'a diary.
topics.description_ur: دعا کو عبادت کی روح سمجھنا اور اپنی تمام دینی و دنیاوی تمناؤں کو باقاعدہ ڈائری میں لکھ کر مانگنا۔

topics.description_ur: حج کے ارکان کو سنت کے مطابق ادا کرنے کے لیے پیشگی علم حاصل کرنا، نوٹس بنانا اور غلطیوں سے حفاظت کی تیاری۔

topics.description_en: The doctrinal status of Hajj as an indispensable pillar of Islam incumbent once in a lifetime upon capable individuals.
